mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production growth above 1.0% year-over-year, supply chain normalization improves corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 indicates strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate severe demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: During federal funds rate below 1.0%, accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.
